item.title: NGINX ngx http v2 module vulnerability
item.description: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use HTTP/2 for client connections and proxy client requests to a backend, a specially crafted request can result in use-after-free in the worker process, if this process is running low on worker connections. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR. Impact:…

item.description: This issue affects NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/2. When NGINX processes undisclosed traffic, the flow control window can exceed the allowed threshold, potentially resulting in a heap buffer overflow typically followed by an NGINX worker segmentation fault. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker…

item.title: RCE via stale global state
item.description: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code…

item.title: RCE via OOM corruption
item.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code…

The server certificate is not verified, and a configured client certificate is…

item.description: Summary Executrix.getCommand() constructs shell commands by substituting temporary file paths directly into a /bin/sh -c string with no escaping. The IN FILE ENDING and OUT FILE ENDING configuration keys flow into those paths unmodified. A place author who sets either key to a shell metacharacter sequence achieves arbitrary OS command execution in the JVM's security context when the place processes any payload. No…

item.description: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw was found in KubeVirt's virt-api port-forward handler. When processing a port-forward request to a VirtualMachineInstance (VMI), virt-api reads the target IP from vmi.Status.Interfaces 0 .IP and passes it directly to net.Dial() without validation. item.title: bep/imagemeta: Unbounded memory allocation decoding PNG zTXt "Raw profile type iptc" chunks
item.description: A crafted PNG can make imagemeta.Decode allocate memory far in excess of the input file's size, leading to memory exhaustion.
